parsed.explanation: The strongest trans-specific evidence is state enforcement against gender expression: a 2018 presentation-based arrest and a 2023 cross-dressing conviction resulting in civil imprisonment, both under neutral public-decency provisions. A 2019 police coercion incident shows state-agent sexual coercion, and the record documents impunity and no reporting route. Advocacy is criminalised under Article 392, and neutral loitering and immorality provisions are used against LGBTQ people. Custody and HIV/STD care discrimination is documented, and no gender-marker route or anti-discrimination statute exists. Recourse is weak. The 2015 account of tourist-targeting policing is dated and single-source, so it is weighted lightly. No organised sweeps, capital penalty or trans-specific facility or custody rule is documented, so this sits in the high-risk band, not the severe one. Trans-specific measurement is thin, so I extrapolated from criminalisation, documented enforcement and impunity.
